primitives.meaning: a confirmed booking with a scheduled time; at least one prerequisite recorded as outstanding and owned by the customer
entryFilters: the booking is confirmed in the system of record and its scheduled time is in the future
the customer is contactable for service messages about this booking
no reminder has been sent for this occurrence
hard gates (GLB-31) permit service communication to this person

primitives.asks: Is there enough time left for a prompt to be worth sending?

branches.label: Time remains
branches.test: the scheduled time is far enough out that an outstanding prerequisite could still be completed

branches.label: Too close to prompt
branches.test: the booking is already inside its pre-start window

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the message lists things to read and do over time, or no urgent channel is permitted
the person is in the product

primitives.purpose: Every outstanding prerequisite, whose it is and the point by which each must be done - in one message rather than one per requirement.
primitives.brief: Name every outstanding prerequisite, whose it is and the point by which it has to be done, in one message rather than one message per requirement. Somebody with three things to do has one problem, and splitting it into three makes it look like three systems that do not talk
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

cancelOn.meaning: every customer-owed prerequisite is recorded complete
the booking is cancelled, moved or materially changed

primitives.reads: the booking re-read from authoritative state: still confirmed, same time, same provider, and which prerequisites are outstanding now

branches.label: All complete
branches.test: every prerequisite the customer owed is recorded satisfied

branches.label: Booking changed
branches.test: the booking was cancelled, moved or materially changed

cancelOn.meaning: the booking is cancelled, moved or materially changed

primitives.reads: the booking re-read from authoritative state before either the at-risk notice or the reminder is built

primitives.does: Re-read the booking from authoritative current state before anything is sent - still confirmed, same time, same provider, and which prerequisites are outstanding now. A reminder generated from the booking as it was is how somebody who cancelled correctly gets told to turn up

primitives.asks: Does the booking still stand as it was just read?

branches.label: Still valid
branches.test: the booking is confirmed, at the time recorded, and deliverable

branches.label: Cancelled, moved or superseded
branches.test: current state no longer matches the booking this reminder was scheduled against

primitives.asks: Is anything outstanding that would stop the service happening?

branches.label: Critical prerequisite missing
branches.test: a requirement the service cannot be delivered without is still not satisfied

branches.label: Nothing critical outstanding
branches.test: everything blocking is done, whatever remains is not blocking

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the scheduled time is within the same day, or a critical prerequisite is outstanding, and permission for service SMS is recorded
the message lists things to read and do over time, or no urgent channel is permitted

primitives.purpose: The reminder plus the one thing that will stop this going ahead, with the last point at which it can still be done. The confirmed time is not moved.
primitives.brief: Send the reminder and name the one thing that will stop this going ahead, with the last point at which it can still be done. The confirmed time is not moved here - a prerequisite failing is a reason to warn somebody, not a reason to rewrite a commitment they have planned around
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.on: a booking reaching its pre-start point with a critical prerequisite still outstanding
carries: which prerequisite is missing and when it was last prompted
that the customer has been told, and what they were told

orderedRoles.eligibleWhen: the scheduled time is within the same day, or a critical prerequisite is outstanding, and permission for service SMS is recorded
the message lists things to read and do over time, or no urgent channel is permitted
the person is in the product

primitives.purpose: The time, the place or joining route, and anything still outstanding that does not block the service.
primitives.brief: Remind them of the time, the place or joining route, and anything still outstanding that does not block it. One reminder per occurrence - a second one sent because nothing could tell that the first arrived is how people stop reading them
primitives.label: CANONICAL_RULE

primitives.on: reminded against a revalidated booking; the start window and attendance belong to pre-service revalidation
carries: what the reminder said and when it was sent
the prerequisites still outstanding that do not block the service
suppresses: any further reminder for this occurrence

primitives.state: superseded; the booking changed before the reminder was due
primitives.reEntry: the booking that replaced it runs its own readiness from its own confirmation
